title: modfence.toml (version 1)
description: The repository's `modfence.toml`, as JSON (TOML tables map to objects, `[[x]]` arrays of tables to arrays). Unknown keys are errors. See docs/adrs/0004-config-annotations-and-rules.md.

exclude.description: Gitignore-style globs, relative to the config file, added to the ignore files the walker already honours.

layers.description: Layer names from the highest layer to the lowest. A layer may depend on itself and on any layer below it; an edge from a lower layer to a higher one is an error under the reserved rule id `layers`, evaluated before every explicit rule. In deny mode an edge that obeys the order counts as permitted. Nodes with no `layer` tag, or a tag not listed here, are exempt.

default.description: `allow` (default): a dependency no rule decided is permitted. `deny`: a dependency between two of the repository's own modules that no rule and no layers permission decided is a violation of the reserved rule `default-deny`; imports of external packages stay allowed unless a rule forbids them.

accumulate.description: Tag keys whose values are the union across config entries, module annotations and symbol annotations. Other keys take the highest level that sets them (ADR 0004).

require_reason.description: Whether `modfence: ignore[...]` must carry reason="...". Defaults to true.

tagKey.description: Lowercase; `path`, `package`, `lang` and `kind` are reserved selector keys and cannot be tags.

tagValue.description: Any non-empty string without double quotes or control characters (the inline syntax quotes values that contain spaces).

match.description: Gitignore-style glob over repository-relative paths; tags the matching package, module and symbol nodes.

package.description: Glob over external package names; tags the matching external nodes.

additionalProperties.description: A string, or a list of strings for several values (for example `adr = ["0028", "0029"]`).

selector.description: AND across keys, OR within a list of values; a key matches a node if any of the node's values for it matches. A key is a tag name, or one of the reserved keys path (glob), package (glob), lang (py|ts|rs) and kind (package|module|symbol|external).

id.description: Unique; `layers`, `default-deny` and ids starting with `modfence/` are reserved.

kinds.description: Edge relations the rule applies to. Defaults to all three. Heuristic `calls` edges still need `confidence = "any"`.

confidence.description: Omitted: `imports` and `binds` edges of any confidence count, `calls` edges only when resolved. `resolved`: only resolved edges count (never a `binds` edge). `any`: every edge counts, heuristic calls included.
